names: navigation hashes select views only and never treat payment or script input as state
public activity authentication and ban errors end the portal session with the correct notice
revocation clears personal snapshots immediately and rejects results from an earlier login
client level alone cannot enable registration without server eligibility and an owned character
past, future, public and disabled phases remain locked even if a stale payload says eligible
registered entitlement always presents public-launch reservation and cannot be registered again
claim history includes only server-confirmed registrations and preserves stable reward order
every new HTML label and activity key is translated in all nine existing languages
logged-out campaign rules contain no fabricated level, progress bar, eligibility or claim action
registered titles and outfits render as reservations rather than immediate delivery
personal rendering uses exact server values, excludes test orders and treats remote names as text
activity failure never promotes saved registration buttons while history remains visible
carryover records do not imply a settled return or replace the actual character wallet
campaign replies cannot invent reward IDs, amounts, received mail or cash provenance
campaign claim binds current memory session and sends no amount, level, account or launch date
account status works without a selected character and cannot send a bearer to another origin
campaign response after sign-out cannot restore the previous player's reservations
payment links cannot change provider, protocol, port or authority
catalogue rejects mixed order states, duplicate offers and invalid balances
only the current authenticated character can become an order recipient
checkout sends identifiers only, never client price, identity or paid claims
lost reply and reload keep the same nonce and isolate accounts, characters and offers
unavailable or corrupt storage stops financial requests
HTTP billing uses a memory bearer, no cookies, redirects or cached personal data
a reply received after sign-out cannot revive the old account
native browser fetch keeps its Window receiver when called through the session
website sign-out clears memory immediately and revokes only its own grant before closing
nine languages cover every visible text and include RTL and locale normalization
the page never treats a return query as payment authority or renders remote HTML
